success_scope: separate per case, group, and prescribed endpoint

reference_policy.comparison: choose first smaller passing ALL six cases vs next larger

initial_data.original: unchanged normalized Gaussian on n=0..32, k0=2, sigma=.5, equal +/- branches; zero padding
initial_data.chirped: same amplitudes; both branches multiplied by exp(0.5 i (k-2)^2), minus branch additionally exp(i*pi/3); no renormalization

mechanism.hard_norm: full complex branch spectrum r/sqrt(sum |r|^2); exact derivative; no clamp; forward used in loss and evaluation
mechanism.static_carrier: exp(-i t omega(k)); one-input net initialized to original t=0 rate
mechanism.analytic_carrier: exp(-i t (+/- sqrt(k^2+m^2))); explicit known-free-operator prior
mechanism.learned_carrier_training: complete H0 spinor residual, both nonzero unit initial branches; no energy labels or reference
mechanism.joint: static carrier and same envelope from scratch; no free loss; joint full PDE; primary 20000, prescribed 26000 cost-budget endpoint
mechanism.no_carrier: same single tanh complex envelope, same full hard norm; primary20000, prescribed26000 endpoint
mechanism.factors: original/static pretrained carrier x PDE-only/hard norm; analytic hard; joint static hard; no carrier hard
mechanism.pairing: bitwise same-shaped envelope initialization, same time RNG, phase/rate-matched carrier initial condition
mechanism.inference_precomputed_carrier: none; all network and carrier evaluations included

baselines.architecture: spectral PINN adaptations with same hard IC, full hard norm and PDE, not literal published solver reproduction
baselines.candidate_score: mean dev spinor/.10 + current/.15 + modal/.10 + (1-fidelity)/.02; all failed last, fixed index tie-break
baselines.strongest_family: best global development score, fixed family order tie-break

extensions.learned_carrier_reuse: m5T5 static same seed; same m,k,domain and T, only V or IC differs; envelope retrained from matched new Adam
extensions.zero_shot: evaluate unchanged m5T5 complete solution checkpoint on V04/two_harmonics/chirped; no correction of IC or weights; all 3 methods and 5 seeds; diagnostic only

statistics.primary_pair: learned_hard vs analytic_hard at20000 in T10 and m10
statistics.confidence_interval: paired difference Student-t df4 95%; descriptive assumptions; all seeds shown
statistics.learning_advantage_gate: in EACH T10 and m10, paired spinor mean difference<0, upper95CI<0, >=4/5 lower error, absolute pass; lower total attributed training time for efficiency claim

costs.incurred: each unique carrier and tuning run once
costs.attributed: standalone method includes full6000 auxiliary cost; tuning cost separately and as all-benchmark-development overhead
costs.reuse: actual m5 carrier reuse disclosed; amortized examples1,5,10,100; no break-even claims without measured benefit

resources.preflight_time_estimate: historical coupled4000-7200 sec, carrier~1400 sec; 300-400 bound-core hours + evaluation; 3-5 days at five workers

stop_conditions: numeric failure retained, no fresh rerun; dependencies marked failed
engineering interruption: exact optimizer/weights/RNG resume, same plan and budget
free E space below4GiB: stop checkpoint boundary, operational storage correction only
all preset attempts, verification, visual QA, literature and links executed: finish, regardless of scientific failures
forbidden: claim structural norm conservation demonstrates dynamics
